outcome: Visual analog scale score for pain
Newborn partial arterial pressure of oxygen
cohort: Parturient women undergoing vaginal delivery or cesarean section
finding: Epidural administration of 0.08% ropivacaine with 0.5 μg/mL dexmedetomidine provided effective pain management with a lower incidence of bradycardia and hypotension in mothers and higher partial arterial pressure of oxygen in newborns compared to other tested regimens.
